# FluxFlow

> AI agent harness with a modular tool system, provider-agnostic model routing, skills, and sub-agents. CLI-first with a IDE companion for Editor context.

# Routes

## Docs Pages

- [Getting Started](/getting-started): Install, first run, and initial setup of the FluxFlow harness.
- [Startup Arguments](/startup-args): CLI flags and command-line options accepted at launch.
- [App Commands](/app-commands): In-app commands and the slash-command system reference.
- [Model Management](/models): Stable model list, provider configuration, and model routing behavior.
- [API Keys & Providers](/api-keys): How to add and manage API keys across supported providers.
- [Architecture](/architecture): System architecture, design decisions, and skill-injection model.
- [Tools & Capabilities](/tools): Full reference of agent tools, action formats, sub-agents, and workspace actions.

## Changelog

- [Changelog](/changelog): Version history rendered in a modal overlay.
